name: H05_hare_apparent_counts_when_the_trigger_resolves
note: Hare Apparent: the number of Rabbits is counted as the ability resolves (CR 608.2), not when it triggers. A second Hare Apparent enters with its trigger waiting on the stack; in response the first Hare Apparent is put into the graveyard. When the trigger resolves P0 controls no other Hare Apparent, so no Rabbit is created.
